name: YouTube Transcript
description: TranscriptAPI provides REST endpoints for YouTube transcripts, search, channel and playlist data, plus an MCP server.
auth_notes: API key from the dashboard, sent in the Authorization header as a Bearer value on every request; the ChatGPT MCP route uses OAuth.
gate_detail: Keys come from the account dashboard without any stated approval. Most endpoints consume credits per call, while info and latest-videos endpoints are free; free signup credits and plan prices are not stated.
api_scope: Transcript extraction, video info and metadata, YouTube search, channel videos, posts and sections, and playlist videos, with a Swagger UI for interactive testing.
mcp_notes: MCP documentation is published on transcriptapi.com with tools for transcripts, search, channels and playlists; server URL is not shown in the sources.
blocker_detail: Calls consume credits, and whether a free allowance exists or payment is needed first is not established in the sources.

evidence.quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication. Include your API key in the Authorization header of every request:
Don’t have an API key yet? Get one from your dashboard .
Try our Swagger UI where you can make live requests right in your browser.
Use TranscriptAPI to fetch transcripts, search YouTube, browse channels, and list playlists
Step-by-step guide to connect TranscriptAPI with ChatGPT using OAuth

issues: Credit pricing and any free allowance are not stated for transcriptapi.com.
Webhook support is not mentioned for transcriptapi.com; other sources describe different vendors.
MCP server URL is not shown.
